name: Table CSV Encoding
changes: New Send feedback command. It opens a page where you can report a problem or suggest an idea.
Scans the vault when the folder path is empty or root.
Adds Markdown table export with a UTF-8 BOM option, a CSV preview, and new file names.
changes_user: New Send feedback command. It opens a page where you can report a problem or suggest an idea.
Settings now end with a More from NoteMods group, where you can turn this tab off or open it again.
tip: Turn on the BOM option when a spreadsheet app needs a clear UTF-8 signal. The CSV file then starts with the bytes EF BB BF.
thanks: Hi, I am Michael, a solo developer in Poland. Table CSV Encoding is one of over 100 small plugins that I make. Thank you for trusting it with your tables.
